name: io.github.orvenix-ai/varikan
title: VARIKAN: check suppliers before you pay
description: Sanctions screening (OFAC, EU, UK, UN), bank-change fraud checks and supplier due diligence.

tools.name: varikan_services
tools.description: List VARIKAN's human-reviewed checks (Supplier Check, VARIKAN Watch, car seller check), what each covers, price, turnaround and limits.

tools.name: prepayment_supplier_checklist
tools.description: Return a practical checklist to verify an overseas supplier before a first payment, including links to the official US, EU, UK and UN sanctions search tools.

supplier_country.description: Country where the supplier is registered, e.g. China, Turkey

tools.name: analyze_bank_change_request
tools.description: Analyse an email that asks to pay a new or changed bank account and return red flags, a verdict (hold_payment, verify_before_paying, no_strong_flags) and next steps. Also screens the supplier and new payee names against official sanctions lists and checks the sender domain's registration age. Nothing is stored. Do not include full account numbers.

email_text.description: The text of the email or message (account numbers can be removed)

known_supplier_domain.description: The supplier's real website or email domain you already trust, e.g. example.com

new_payee_name.description: Account holder name given for the new bank account

tools.name: screen_sanctions
tools.description: Fuzzy-screen a company, person, vessel or bank-account holder name against the official US OFAC (SDN and non-SDN), EU, UK and UN sanctions lists, refreshed daily. Returns potential matches with list, programme, entry id, score and the official page to verify. Handles word order, punctuation, legal suffixes, accents, Cyrillic and small spelling differences.

name.description: Name to screen (company, person, vessel or account holder)

type.description: Restrict to one kind of party (default any)

country.description: Country context, for your record only

tools.name: check_domain
tools.description: Look up a domain in the official registry (RDAP): registration date, age in days, registrar, expiry and status. Flags very new domains, a classic sign of lookalike supplier sites and spoofed emails.

tools.name: request_supplier_check
tools.description: Send a request to VARIKAN for a human-reviewed check. VARIKAN replies by email within 1 business day with the scope and an invoice; nothing is charged before the requester agrees. Two steps: call first without user_confirmed to get a preview of exactly what will be sent; show it to the user; call again with user_confirmed: true only after the user explicitly approves it. Only use this when the user asks to order or request a check. Never include bank account numbers, passwords or card details.

user_confirmed.description: Set to true only after the user has seen the preview and approved sending it. Omit or false to get the preview; nothing is sent.

requester_name.description: Full name of the person requesting

requester_email.description: Email address VARIKAN should reply to

supplier_name.description: Name of the supplier or seller to check

details.description: Supplier website, what is being bought and the approximate amount (at least 20 characters). No bank details.
